items.text: The system checks sources every 6 hours. If a source fails, the last valid data is kept and, after three consecutive failures, the team is alerted. Generated: 20/10/2026.
Mapping: ICGC (CC BY 4.0). District and neighbourhood boundaries: Ajuntament de Barcelona · CartoBCN (CC BY 4.0).

Prices: Ajuntament de Barcelona · Portal de Dades. Sales: average price per m² of the homes transferred according to the Consejo General del Notariado; rent: average monthly rent of the contracts according to the INCASÒL deposits. Main figure: last full year (2025); in the charts, the current year appears as provisional.
Density: Padró municipal 2026 and official area from CartoBCN.

Brokered properties (Properties): the location on the map is approximate and the street number is not shown. The price is that of the published listing, not the final sale price, and the figures add up those listing prices. The date is the month in which the home stopped being advertised.
